newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak rapeseed harvest halted by bad weather.
newsitem.headline: Slovak rapeseed harvest halted by bad weather.

text.p: Slovakia's 1997 rapeseed harvest has been halted due to inclement weather and the yield will probably be lower than forecast, the independent SITA news agency reported on Wednesday.

SITA, quoting a spokesman for Palma Tumys, a.s. Bratislava, Slovakia's major rapeseed processor, said heavy rains in the past week were likely to result in a drop in the per-hectare and rapeseed oil yields.
On Tuesday the Slovak Statistical Bureau said this year's rapeseed harvest was estimated at between 199,000 tonnes and 208,000 tonnes, an increase of 42.6 percent over 1996.
The Palma Tumys spokesman said that 40 tonnes of high quality rapeseed had been processed before the bad weather stopped the harvest operations.
